description: Matched-seed Phase Three mechanism campaign testing MOVE_X/MOVE_Y execution with the calibrated hereditary unit-step mutation channel and explicit atomic movement payment. Both conditions share the same movement opcode and movement-step mutation process, atomic payment rule, resource geography and resource-sensing state; only movement execution differs. The 0.5 movement-step rate is a mechanistic calibration choice, not a biological or optimal mutation-rate claim.
